essence: The spatial path is presented scripturally by means of contraction and expansion.
After explaining the temporal path rooted in action, the text turns to the spatial path rooted in the diversity of forms.
The whole spatial path has no reality apart from its grounding in consciousness.
The spatial path unfolds from consciousness through inner yogic levels into the outer body.
Contemplating the ordered structure of the path is a direct means for the yogi to attain Bhairava-hood.
